title: Measuring and Charging for Retained Context in Long-Context LLM Services
abstract: arXiv:2611.24071v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-context large language model (LLM) services charge for repeated context, yet billing weights need not reflect its contribution to answer quality. We present a three-layer framework separating content relevance, observable proxies and auditable positional weights. Context-ablation experiments show that relevance dominates position and that distance-decay families do not outperform a relevance-only baseline. A measured serving stack shows that cache hits reduce repeated-prefix compute cost by over two orders of magnitude at 65,536 tokens, while cold resends constrain sustainable discounts. Cross-provider measurements separate cache value from tokenisation and list-price differences. Calibrated simulations reduce the 99th percentile of session charges by 31-42%, although revenue-matched nonlinear tariffs achieve similar reductions and median charges increase. translated_title: 长上下文大语言模型服务中保留上下文的度量与计费
translated_abstract: 长上下文大语言模型（LLM）服务对重复上下文进行计费，但其计费权重未必反映其对回答质量的实际贡献。我们提出了一个三层框架，将内容相关性、可观测代理指标和可审计的位置权重分离开来。上下文消融实验表明，相关性因素主导于位置因素，且距离衰减类模型并不优于仅基于相关性的基线。基于实测的服务栈显示，在65,536个token的情况下，缓存命中可将重复前缀的计算成本降低两个数量级以上，而冷重发则限制了可持续折扣的空间。跨提供商的测量将缓存价值与分词方式和标价差异区分开来。经过校准的仿真将会话费用的第99百分位数降低了31-42%，尽管收入匹配的非线性费率也能实现类似降幅，但会使中位数费用有所上升。该框架提供了一个有界的每token计费规则以及实测数据支撑。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个将内容相关性、可观测代理与可审计位置权重分离的三层框架来度量长上下文LLM服务中重复上下文的实际价值，实测表明缓存命中可将重复前缀计算成本降低两个数量级以上，且校准仿真能将会话费用的99百分位降低31-42%。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a three-layer framework separating content relevance, observable proxies, and auditable positional weights to measure the true value of repeated context in long-context LLM services, showing that cache hits reduce repeated-prefix compute cost by over two orders of magnitude and calibrated simulations cut the 99th percentile of session charges by 31-42%.
